title: I'm 33 and I had fun too!!
text:
Fun. Had to put that first. I got this for my 10 year old daughter. She is autistic. Once she finds a topic she likes, she wants tons of information on it. This package is nice because it comes with a puzzle book and a fact book. Which was very well written and attention grabbing. The puzzle book was awesome as well. It's not just random puzzles with that country's facts inserted. As you go through the pages you cross off items, locations, and suspects until you know who did it. Very cool concept. I did this with her and I had fun as well. Parent involvement is not needed to complete. I definitely recommend and we are keeping this subscription going in our house.

label: positive
